label: Check Point Quantum 6200 security gateway
description: 1U enterprise security gateway: eight 10/100/1000BASE-T data ports plus a separate 1G management port and a 1G sync port, one empty network expansion slot, RJ45 and USB-C console. 9 Gbps firewall / 3.72 Gbps NGFW throughput. No PoE.
notes: Datasheet (August 2023): base model 10x 1GbE copper - eight 10/100/1000BASE-T data ports, one management 10/100/1000BASE-T port and one sync 10/100/1000BASE-T port - in 1RU, with one network expansion slot, 2x USB 3.0, RJ45 and USB-C console, 8 GB RAM and a single PSU. The Plus package adds 4x 1GbE fibre and redundant PSUs; the datasheet's max capacity is 18 copper + 4 fibre + 4x 10GbE. None of the optional modules are fitted here, because a spec that ships empty slots as ports invents hardware. 9 Gbps firewall, 3.72 Gbps NGFW, 1.8 Gbps threat prevention.
